mcq.question: A job runs every 10 minutes but one run takes 25 minutes. What happens at the next two slots?

options.A: They are skipped, because the previous run is still busy
options.B: Two extra copies start in parallel
options.C: They are queued and run back to back afterwards

mcq.explanation: No-overlap scheduling never starts a job while its previous run is in progress.

mcq.question: Why does the scheduler take a clock instead of calling `system_clock::now()`?

options.C: Tests and simulations can control time and run a week instantly
options.D: The standard clock cannot represent minutes

mcq.explanation: An injected clock makes time an input, so behaviour at 02:30 can be tested at any time of day.
